description: Update one saved build by ID: rename it, edit notes, patch its portable spec with specPatch, or replace the full spec. specPatch merges field by field: omitted fields survive, nested text entries merge, supplied arrays replace and null removes a field. It needs expectedRevision, the revision from ads_get_build. Changes to spec, webState, mediaItems or uploadBatchId bump the revision. A rename or notes-only update does not bump it. Parallel updates to one build collide on the revision: a stale expectedRevision returns "Build changed since it was read" (HTTP 409), and ads_get_build returns the current revision. spec replaces the whole portable spec. webState is only accepted unchanged from a build that was read; the web uploader regenerates it when it next opens the build, and webStateStale: true until then is normal. Setting a name turns an autosaved build into a kept, named build. An open uploader tab picks up the update automatically. Returns updated metadata and display: totalAdSets, totalAds and the ads in each ad set as the web uploader renders them (display.complete false carries a reason, and display.inheritedFromSource lists fields that come from the source ad or preset); ads_get_build returns the stored state. Uploaded-media texts.perAd keys are file names or media:<uploadId>. CTA fields take Meta enum values such as SHOP_NOW.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by ads_get_build. Required with specPatch and recommended for every update; the update fails instead of overwriting a newer revision.

name.description: New build name. Setting a name marks the build as manually saved, so it stops rotating out with autosaves.

notes.description: Free-form notes stored on the build.

spec.description: Replacement portable spec (the launch configuration used by ads_create with buildId). Send the FULL updated spec object, not a partial diff. Set to null to clear it.

specPatch.description: Preferred for content edits. Field-aware merge patch applied to the stored portable spec: omitted fields survive, nested objects (including individual texts.perAd/perAdset entries) merge, supplied arrays replace, and null removes a field. Requires expectedRevision. Computed launchability metadata cannot be patched.

webState.description: Opaque web uploader session snapshot. Do not construct this object by hand. Only send it when round-tripping a webState previously read from the build without changing its structure. For content changes, update spec only; the web uploader regenerates webState on its next resume.

name: ads_update_build
title: Update Saved Build
